Projekt był okazją do połączenia UI, mot: The project was an opportunity to combine UI, motion and AI-assisted development. Refining the design directly in the browser was especially valuable: I could assess responsiveness and animation behaviour alongside the static layout.

Projekt koncepcyjny na bazie projektu ko: Concept based on a client project
Mova to koncepcja aplikacji do nauki jęz: Mova is a language-learning app concept based on a client project. I focused on lesson structure, progress feedback and a consistent mobile and web interface that supports learning without competing with the material.
Znalezienie równowagi między motywującym: Finding a balance between a motivating interface and a calm learning space, without excessive gamification or overwhelming amounts of content.
Zaprojektowanie aplikacji, która prowadz: Design an app that guides learners through the material step by step and clearly shows their progress.
Projekt widoków mobile i web ze struktur: Mobile and web designs with structured lessons, feedback and a UI kit ready to support additional screens.
Porównałam Duolingo, Babbel i Busuu, prz: I compared Duolingo, Babbel and Busuu, looking at habit building, progress feedback and how they guide learners through the material. This helped define Mova's direction: short learning stages, a clear place within the course structure and fewer distractions from the content.
Te założenia przełożyłam na architekturę: I translated these principles into the app architecture. Lessons are grouped into topic-based modules, each following a sequence of material, exercises and a summary. A dictionary and flashcards add independent revision, with a particular focus on quick mobile sessions.
Bieżący moduł stanowi centrum widoku, a: The current module is the focus of the screen, with progress indicators playing a supporting role. Learners should see where they are in the course and what they can do next, without dominant leaderboards or extra distractions. I used the orange brand colour mainly for actions, navigation and progress indicators.
Dużo uwagi poświęciłam informacji zwrotn: I paid close attention to feedback in exercises and summaries. The messages show what went well, where a mistake occurred and what to improve. The dictionary and flashcards let learners revisit selected vocabulary outside the main lesson flow.
Mobile i web — dwa konteksty nauki: Mobile and web — two learning contexts
Mobile i web potraktowałam jako dwa kont: I treated mobile and web as two learning contexts. The mobile version is designed for short sessions and quick revision, while the web version supports longer study. Both share the same logic and visual language, with layouts adapted to the available space.
Warstwę wizualną Mova oparłam na jasnych: Mova's visual design uses light surfaces, neutral shades and an orange accent to highlight primary actions, navigation and learning progress. Nunito Sans gives the app a friendly feel, while its different weights establish a content hierarchy without excessive decoration.
Te zasady przełożyłam na UI Kit obejmują: I turned these principles into a UI kit covering lesson components, tags and interaction states. Typography styles and Figma Variables organise shared values, making it easier to keep mobile and web consistent and develop new screens.
Mova — paleta kolorów, typografia i UI K: Mova — colour palette, typography and UI kit
Powstała koncepcja aplikacji łączącej up: The result is an app concept that combines a structured course journey with independent revision. The project let me explore information hierarchy in an educational product and the differences between designing for a phone and a computer.
Kolejnym krokiem byłyby testy prototypu: The next step would be to test the prototype with language learners. I would check whether the lesson structure, progress indicators and feedback are clear. I would also develop onboarding that introduces the app's features gradually.

Autorska koncepcja marki i strony studia: An original brand and website concept for an interior design studio. The project became a space to explore the relationship between a logo, typography, photography and a calm interface.
Chciałam stworzyć spójny wizerunek studi: I wanted to create a coherent identity for an interior design studio, covering both branding and a website. The starting point was a calm, architectural direction: restrained typography, a regular grid and large interior photographs.
Zaprojektowałam logo OBRYS i jego warian: I designed the OBRYS logo and its colour variations. The open form of the mark, muted green and Archivo typography create a shared visual language that I then applied to the website.

Koncept aplikacji mobilnej do planowania: A mobile app concept for trip planning: research, user flows, voting, comments and a generated itinerary.
ReadySet — wspólny wyjazd, jeden plan |: ReadySet — one trip, one plan | Portfolio
ReadySet to koncepcja aplikacji mobilnej: ReadySet is a mobile app concept for planning trips as a group. It brings suggestions, voting and an agreed itinerary together to help participants make decisions collectively.
Pomysły i ustalenia dotyczące wyjazdu gi: Trip ideas and decisions get lost in conversations, and bringing them together into one plan takes extra work.
Zaprojektowanie miejsca, w którym grupa: Design a shared space where a group can suggest options, choose between them and build an itinerary together.
Interaktywny prototyp aplikacji, sprawdz: An interactive app prototype tested through selected tasks.
Chciałam zrozumieć, jak grupy organizują: I wanted to understand how groups organise trips and when planning becomes complicated and chaotic. I conducted three in-depth interviews with people who organise group travel.
Pytałam o doświadczenia z ostatnich podr: I asked about their recent trips: the biggest difficulties, how they shared information and made decisions, and what they wanted to simplify. These exploratory conversations helped me identify problems worth investigating further.
W FigJam pogrupowałam wypowiedzi w obsza: I grouped the interview quotes by theme in FigJam. Three connected difficulties emerged:
Komunikatory umożliwiają szybką wymianę: Messaging apps make it easy to share ideas quickly, but harder to find specific suggestions and decisions later.
Linki, arkusze i wiadomości przechowują: Links, spreadsheets and messages hold different parts of the plan. Putting the whole picture together means switching between them.
Trudno rozpoznać ostateczną decyzję: Final decisions are hard to identify
Ankiety i ustalenia pozostają w historii: Polls and agreements stay buried in chat history. It isn't always clear what has been approved and what still needs discussion.
ReadySet — obszary problemowe i synteza: ReadySet — problem areas and research synthesis

Wnioski przełożyłam na pytania How Might: I translated the findings into How Might We questions, Jobs to Be Done and a storyboard. These defined three jobs for the app: organise suggestions, show the progress of decisions and provide easy access to the final plan.
Na tej podstawie rozdzieliłam aplikację: Based on this, I divided the app into “Planning” and “Itinerary”. The first is a space for sharing ideas and making decisions; the second shows the agreed plan. This distinction became the foundation for the information architecture and screen design.
Powiększ obraz: ReadySet — przepływ plan: Enlarge image: ReadySet — planning and itinerary flow
Propozycje uporządkowałam w kategoriach,: I organised suggestions into categories such as accommodation and transport. Each suggestion has its own status, voting and comments, keeping the discussion tied to a specific topic. Participants can see what needs a decision without searching through chat history.
W koncepcji uwzględniłam dodawanie propo: The concept includes adding suggestions via a link, with the name and image fetched automatically to reduce manual input. Selected options go into an itinerary that can be exported as a PDF and kept for the trip.
Interfejs oparty na Material Design: An interface based on Material Design
Interfejs oparłam na komponentach Materi: I based the interface on Material Design components, adapting their appearance to ReadySet. This let me focus on the app's structure while keeping familiar interaction patterns.
Klikalny prototyp sprawdziłam z kilkoma: I tested the clickable prototype with a few friends. I asked them to add a category and a suggestion, and navigate the app. I wanted to assess whether the structure and basic actions were clear.
Uczestnicy pozytywnie oceniali przejrzys: Participants responded positively to the clarity of the information and ease of navigation. However, this was an initial assessment with people I knew, rather than a test of a whole group planning a real trip.

Powstał prototyp łączący zbieranie pomys: The resulting prototype brings together collecting ideas, making decisions and accessing an itinerary. The biggest challenge was presenting a lot of information and states while keeping suggestions clearly distinct from agreed decisions.
Kolejnym krokiem byłoby sprawdzenie apli: The next step would be to test the app while planning a real trip. This would help assess group collaboration, the need for a guest mode and whether the solution helps people reach decisions. Interface accessibility and the reliability of fetching data from links would need separate validation.
